messages:
claire: opened a PR to reconcile the Stratus-XP model card with the catalog matrix. Main changes: clarify supported runtimes, add a "Migration notes" section for customers moving to stratus-xp-quant, fix an outdated link to the quant guide, and include a short bench table. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5128 :memo:
noah: thanks. Can you call out the sequence ceiling for the quant path? We've seen deterministic KV cache truncation beyond 8192 tokens on edge devices.
ruth: also add an explicit note about runtime compatibility: runtime 3.1 -> partial for stratus-xp-quant (missing fused-attn); runtime 3.3+ -> full. Put this in the compatibility matrix row with a short explanation.
claire: will add. For the benchmark table - do we want p50 latency or tokens/sec? I suggest both but keep it minimal: p50 @ seq512 and tok/s @ seq512, batch=1.
noah: that works. I'll paste microbench numbers in a sec. Also there's a stale link to docs/old-quantization.md in the card, replace with docs/quant/overview.md and add a redirect entry.
claire: thanks, I'll swap the link and open a tiny redirect PR after merge. Assigning follow-ups: noah 12bench CSV and numbers; ruth 12compat blurb; I'll update the PR draft and ask for one review.
noah: uploading CSV now. Benchnotes: p4d fp16 (stratus-xp): p50=68ms (seq512), toks/s=760; stratus-xp-quant (runtime 3.3 + selector): p50=72ms, toks/s=740; quant on runtime 3.1 (fallback kernel): toks/s=610. I'll attach raw CSV.
docs-bot: PR #5128 opened by claire: docs/model-catalog: stratus-xp card reconciliation + migration notes (labels: docs, model-catalog)
ruth: small wording nit: when describing routing fallback use explicit phrasing: "When an exact pinned variant is unschedulable, the platform will fall back to a compatible variant and emit audit event MODEL_PIN_FALLBACK." Clear and prescriptive.
claire: done. Also adding a short SDK snippet showing exact pin vs family pin vs unpinned. Example:
```
# exact pin
client.generate(model="stratus-xp@2026-04-01", prompt="...")
# family pin (allow compatible variants)
client.generate(model="stratus-xp@stable", prompt="...")
# unpinned
client.generate(model="stratus-xp", prompt="...")
```
noah: LGTM. One more: add a short note about when to prefer pinning (stability, reproducibility) vs allowing family pins (automatic performance + security patches).
claire: added that paragraph. Requesting reviews after CI. If no major comments I'll merge with one approval. :thumbsup:
noah: +1
ruth: +1
claire: merging after CI then, thanks everyone! :rocket:
